_comment: DeepSpeed ZeRO-2: shards gradients and optimizer states, but keeps a full
copy of the parameters on every rank. Faster than ZeRO-3 because it needs
no parameter gathering, and sufficient whenever the model fits in memory -
which for LoRA it does, since only the adapters carry optimizer state.
Use this for multi-GPU LoRA runs; use ZeRO-3 for full-parameter training,
where the parameters themselves must be sharded.
'auto' values come from TrainingArguments so batch size and precision are
configured in one place, the YAML, and cannot drift out of agreement.
